evidence.title: GitHub - abi/screenshot-to-code: Drop in a screenshot and convert it to clean code (HTML/Tailwind/React/Vue)

name: screenshot-to-code
summary: AI tool that converts screenshots, mockups, Figma designs and screen recordings into HTML, React or Vue code.
description: Open-source app that turns screenshots, mockups, Figma designs and screen recordings into clean front-end code using AI models such as Gemini, GPT and Claude. Outputs HTML + Tailwind or CSS, React + Tailwind, Vue + Tailwind, Bootstrap and Ionic. Runs locally with a React/Vite frontend and FastAPI backend (Docker or Poetry) using your own API keys, or through the official hosted app at screenshottocode.com; an optional headless-Chromium tool lets the agent preview and visually check its own output.
contains: converts screenshots, mockups, Figma designs and screen recordings into code
output stacks: HTML + Tailwind/CSS, React + Tailwind, Vue + Tailwind, Bootstrap, Ionic
React/Vite frontend and FastAPI backend; Docker one-command setup
bring your own API keys (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Replicate)
optional headless Chromium screenshot preview tool
